en: Part-time Stock Assistant | Fictional Shop D029 | **June 2025–August 2026**
zh: 兼职库存助理｜虚构商店D029｜**2025年6月—2026年8月**

en: Checked inbound cartons against delivery notes and reported damaged packaging to the shift lead.
zh: 依据送货单检查入库纸箱，并向班次负责人报告包装损坏。

en: Used a handheld scanner to record stock movements and followed assigned shelf-location codes.
zh: 使用手持扫描器记录库存移动，并遵循指定货架位置编码。

en: Helped relabel 60 shelf positions in one stockroom zone using an approved location map. In 20 sampled retrievals from that zone after relabeling, median lookup time fell from 4 to 3 minutes; the shift team performed the work.
zh: 依据获批位置图，协助为一个库房区域的60个货架位置重新贴标。重新贴标后，在该区域抽样的20次取货中，查找时间中位数从4分钟降至3分钟，工作由班次团队完成。

en: Supported weekly cycle counts and passed variances to the stock controller rather than independently changing balances.
zh: 协助每周循环盘点，并将差异提交库存管理员，而非独立调整余额。

en: Certificate in Retail Operations | Fictional Institute D029 | **Completed 2025**
zh: 零售运营结业证书｜虚构院校D029｜**完成时间：2025年**
